notes.title: PATCH 1.0.7 – Update Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY.
We are pleased to announce the details of the update released on August 25, 2025.

[h3][b]▼Version Information[/b]
1.0.7[/h3]

[h3][b]▼Update Contents[/b][/h3]
[h3]●Graphics-Related Issues[/h3]
- Fixed an issue in ""PATAPON"" and ""PATAPON 2"" where some Patapon units had graphical display problems.
- Fixed an issue in ""PATAPON 2"" where the color of the map object ""Kacheek (stone)"" was different from the intended color.
- Fixed unintended behaviors that occurred in some in-game cutscenes.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2383200/view/788814720766313631]*This resolves the issue that was announced on August 6, 2025.[/url]

[h3]●Hero Class Selection Issue[/h3]
- Fixed an issue in “PATAPON 2"" where, it was sometimes impossible to correctly select the class for Hero unit in HEADQUARTERS.
[In Case You Face an Issue with the Unit Formation Screen]
Even after applying this update, some players may still experience issues with their Patapon units' formation or equipment not being correctly reflected, depending on the save data.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and kindly request that affected players try the following steps:
[h3]＜How to Resolve Equipment Status Issues for Patapon Units＞[/h3]
1.	Restart the game application and your PlayStation®5/Nintendo Switch™/Steam console.
2.	In HEADQUARTERS (Unit Formation Screen), execute ""Optimize"" for all three Patapon units (excluding Hero unit).
o	Procedure: ""Equip"" → ""Optimize"" → Select ""Yes"" at the prompt "" Optimizing army equip. Are you sure?""
[h3]＜How to Resolve Class Formation Issues for Patapon Units＞[/h3]
1.	Restart the game application and your PlayStation®5/Nintendo Switch™/Steam console.
2.	In HEADQUARTERS (Unit Formation Screen), remove the formation of all three Patapon units (excluding Hero unit) and then re-form them.
o	Procedure: ""Remove"" → ""Formation"" → Select the unit of the class you wish to re-form → ""Confirm""

We appreciate your continued support for PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY.

notes.title: Addressing Input Timing Concerns in PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Thank you for your continued support of PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY![/b][/h3]

We've received a few reports from players noticing a slight desynchronization between command inputs and sound timing. This issue may be related to individual hardware setups or audio/video configurations.
If you're experiencing this, here are a few suggestions that may help improve synchronization:

[h3][b]■Check Your Monitor/TV Mode[/b][/h3]
Try switching your display to “Game Mode” or a similar setting designed to reduce input lag.
Note: This option may not be available on all monitors or TVs.

[h3][b]■Experiment with Audio Output[/b][/h3]
Wireless audio devices can sometimes introduce latency. For best results, try using:
- Wired headphones
- Gaming headsets
- Your device’s built-in speakers

We truly appreciate your continued support and passion for PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY!

notes.title: Patapon 1+2 Replay (Nintendo Switch) Review
notes.notes:
I was genuinely caught off guard by Patapon 1+2 Replay when I first saw it during the March 2025 Nintendo Direct. I know the rails have come almost all the way off in terms of first-party exclusivity, but, like with Crash Bandicoot before it, I never would’ve thought to see something that was pretty indicative of the PlayStation—namely, the PlayStation Portable—winding up on a Nintendo console. 

But it’s certainly an excellent time for Patapon to land on the Nintendo Switch because I question how many people got a chance to play it back in the day. I know the PSP technically sold well, but I genuinely don’t remember anyone owning one, outside of a cousin who always seemed to have all the consoles—he was the only person I knew who had a Dreamcast. I liked Patapon when I first played it back in 2008, and that feeling continues to this day—Patapon 1+2 Replay are excellent, albeit somewhat flawed games that combine creativity with genuine ingenuity.

notes.title: Lead the Patapon march in PATAPON 1+2 REPLAY coming on 11th July 2025 🥁
notes.notes:
[h1][b]PATAPON 1 and 2 reunite in ONE bundle![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558577/366c263255e48bae61021284adb9b77d8fe7d76b.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=ojtnxA61V6Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558577/65ae7910548b778f93fee06237af0d683b8a62ad.png[/img]

[h2]Simple controls and strategic gameplay[/h2]

A charming combination of simplicity and strategic depth. Extremely easy to learn, yet pleasantly challenging to master. 
Rhythmically hit just four drums - [b]PATA (←), PON (⇀), DON (↓), CHAKA (↑)[/b] - to switch commands based on the battle situation and assemble your squad with Patapons of various classes suited to the stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558577/e4d325c2b2f67977474ff83cd6fdd5bf7c888b73.png[/img]

[h2]Packed with replayability - produce new Patapon[/h2]

You can create and enhance your Patapon by combining items. Collect rare materials from stages and mini games to craft stronger Patapon.
With over 400 types of weapons and equipment, you can build your personalized Patapon unit and tackle diverse stages and formidable enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558577/b0ea30e06c979ee0867e46ec0ea9f9342c80c8e6.png[/img]

[h2]New support features for easier play while enjoying the original fun[/h2]

The fun of the original is preserved with updates making it even more accessible and enjoyable!
This package introduces new support features like three difficulty settings (NORMAL, EASY, HARD), timing adjustment, and constant command display.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558577/366c263255e48bae61021284adb9b77d8fe7d76b.png[/img]
